inlines.v: FRUSH, verb transitive To bruise; to crush. obsolete FRUSH, noun In farriery, a sort of tender horn that grows in the middle of the sole of a horse, at some distance from the toe, dividing into two branches, and running toward the heel in the form of a fork.
